meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 git 相关请求时,会先判断属于提交、变基还是历史检索。提交时按目录/关注点拆成多个原子提交,模仿仓库原有提交风格,先给计划再执行;变基/压缩负责重写历史,检索用 blame、bisect、log -S 等定位变更来源。
howto.when: 当用户发起任何 git 操作时触发,典型入口是提交(commit)、变基(rebase)、压缩(squash)等请求。此外,询问“谁写的”“何时加入”或“找引入改动的提交”也会进入历史检索模式。

say.text: 帮我把这次的改动拆成几个独立提交,按目录分开。
say.note: Claude 会先输出提交计划,再逐一执行原子提交。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个,并整理提交信息。
查一下这个文件里某行是谁写的,什么时候加的。

howto.what_en: Claude maps any git request to commit, rebase, or history mode. Commit mode plans multiple atomic commits, imitates repo style, then executes. History mode uses blame, bisect, log -S to locate the change origin.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any git request; typical entries are commit, rebase, or squash. Asking who wrote something, when a change was added, or for the introducing commit also enters history search.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into several independent commits by directory.
say_en.note: Claude shows a commit plan, then makes atomic commits.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one and clean up the messages.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite local history using an autosquash rebase.

say_en.text: Find who wrote that line in this file and when it was added.
say_en.note: Claude will use blame and log -S to trace the origin.
